time_model.function: tools/environment/tickclock.mjs tickToLmtMinutes(tick, anchors): piecewise-linear in the anchors, minutes since 1863-07-01T00:00 LMT
time_model.note: CANDIDATE. Nothing here approves it. The five anchors the plan lists as needing a historian are ticks 75, 90, 248, 275 and 538 (docs/plan/FINAL/00-README.md section 6).

conventions.clock: LMT, minutes since 1863-07-01T00:00 local mean time (lmt_min) and a label "MM-DD HH:MM" (July).
conventions.altitude: Geometric (airless) topocentric altitude of the centre of the body, degrees; azimuth degrees clockwise from north. Refraction would lift a body at the horizon by about 0.6 degree.
conventions.light: day: sun altitude >= -0.8333; civil_twilight >= -6; nautical_twilight >= -12; astronomical_twilight >= -18; night otherwise. Within about a minute of the event times in astro_by_day.
conventions.moon_up: 1 when the moon's altitude >= -0.8333 (same convention; within a minute of the moonrise/moonset times).
conventions.moon_illum_pct: Illuminated fraction of the disc at that instant, percent.
conventions.precision: altitudes 0.01 degree, azimuths 0.1 degree, illumination 0.1 percent; the values are only as good as +-1 minute of clock.
